thread:
nina: Quick alert 10: were seeing intermittent audio dropouts on the rehearsal stream. Need to push meeting start by 8 minutes while we verify encoder routing. cc @video_ops @eng_oncall

harry: ack. can we keep the full Q&A? Id rather shorten internal island updates.

lee: moving the demo later and can skip the remote screen share to save bandwidth.

product_ana: if we delay, can leadership confirm they still want the roadmap deep-dive? i'll prep the shorter version just in case.

ceo_jen: let's do the deep-dive remotely only if stream is stable in 10m. otherwise go to highlights + extended Q&A. prioritize audience questions.

video_ops: investigating: OBS node reports intermittent packet loss to RTMP endpoint. switching primary stream to our fallback ingest cluster `ingest-2`. starting a parallel recording on `rec-node-7`.

eng_oncall: tailing logs: `2026-03-24T02:02:41Z net: tx_errors=12 rtmp_conn=retrying`. Bumped socket buffer and restarted obs-service. Hoping that fixes the dropouts.

nina: thanks. calendar tweak: start +8m, agenda adjusted: cut engineering updates to 5m, move hiring announcements to post-all-hands doc. Q&A extended by 6m.

product_ana: noted. i'll update the shared doc and pin the Q&A thread. link: https://docs.redwood/in/allhands/2026-03-24-update (temp)

harry: question queued for Q&A: how are we prioritizing model quantization work vs. batching optimizations for Dedicated customers?

ceo_jen: short answer: both, but prioritization depends on customer ROI; we'll announce a resourcing plan next quarter. put that in the PRD and we'll share a timeline.

video_ops: recorder on rec-node-7 is healthy and capturing; starting post-processing pipeline to generate clips. primary stream on ingest-2 is stable for now.

eng_oncall: please monitor CPU on `rec-node-7`  it's on a tight thermal envelope; we might want to offload encoding to our encoding pool if CPU > 75%.

nina: copy. whos owning the final publish? I can coordinate the YT upload if video ready.

lee: happy to handle upload and add timestamps. DM me when recording done.

stream-bot: StreamStatus: warm -> live; viewers=198; ingest=ingest-2; backup_rec=rec-node-7; issues=none.

product_ana: follow-ups from leadership to communicate after meeting: (1) grandfathering policy on SLA changes for existing Dedicated customers for 180 days (2) schedule for roadmap deep-dive if needed next Thursday at 10am PT.

ceo_jen: will post a short note in #general after all-hands summarizing the SLA change and next steps. thanks all for the quick pivot. :clap:

nina: starting in 7m now. ping here if anything else pops up.
